alpha_policy: Composite RGBA over dark background RGB(17, 17, 17) to match GPay dark-theme canvas (#111111).
grayscale_policy: Replicate single luminance channel L across all 3 RGB channels (R=G=B).
mask_policy: Binary representation where background=0 and tampered foreground=1 (array) / 255 (display). Dimensions must strictly match screenshot.
interpolation_policy: No spatial resizing or cropping is performed in Phase 2. If mask resizing is ever explicitly requested in future workflows, nearest-neighbor interpolation only.
